BIT_1536 - Enum constant in enum class gratum.pgp.ElGamalKeySize
This is a 1536 bit MODP group safe prime modulus Prime is: 2^1536 - 2^1472 - 1 + 2^64 * { [2^1406 pi] + 741804 }
BIT_2048 - Enum constant in enum class gratum.pgp.ElGamalKeySize
This is a 2048 bit MODP group safe prime modulus Prime is: 2^2048 - 2^1984 - 1 + 2^64 * { [2^1918 pi] + 124476 }

This is a 3072 bit MODP group safe prime modulus Prime is: 2^3072 - 2^3008 - 1 + 2^64 * { [2^2942 pi] + 1690314 }
